This is a placeholder post — it exists so the blog pipeline has something to render. Replace it by editing blog/posts/hello-world.md, or delete the file and run bun run build again.

A quick tour of what the Markdown renderer handles:

  • bold, italic, and inline code
  • links, like the home page
  • fenced code blocks:
func main() {
    fmt.Println("hello, world")
}

Blockquotes too, if you're into that.

Math

Inline math, like E=mc2E = mc^2E=mc2 or O(nlog⁡n)O(n \log n)O(nlogn), and a display equation:

∫01x2 dx=13\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}∫01​x2dx=31​

Underscores and backslashes survive because equations are pulled out before Markdown runs: ∑i=1nai\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i∑i=1n​ai​ renders intact.
